name: com.tl.unity
description: Tl timelines for Unity ECS with Burst. Designers build timelines in Unity's Timeline window with Tl tracks; a Playable Director in a SubScene bakes them, and Burst ISystems play them. Coders write a clip struct, a kind and a track; no extra files, assets or steps.

samples.description: The smallest complete program: a clip, a track, a kind and a column that teleport a player along X on a timeline, plus the system that moves it. Menu Tl Hello > Build Scene, then Play. Start here.

The Force track from five small files: a cube on a grid floor is pushed 4.03 m along X, pauses, and a Return timeline (Play next) pushes it back, forever, with a follow camera and a readout. Tl > Samples > Build Control Demo adds a cube whose Burst job starts a Dash timeline from a clip field. Includes the scene builders and Play and Edit mode tests.

Strike clips raise events that gameplay code turns into sparks, damage on a training dummy (a kind fed by game pulses), a Hurt timeline started on the dummy and a score. Builder, README and a PlayMode test (15 strikes, dummy health 10).

10,000 to 100,000 dancers play one Dance timeline from their own start ticks (hop, spin, glow). Builder, README and a PlayMode bench that prints ns per entity per Tl step and the warm allocation (0 B).

Needs the Motion pack (git URL https://github.com/IAFahim/tl.git?path=/packs/Motion). A cube glides, a sphere breathes and turns red to yellow, a capsule spins and hops while a Priority 5 Move pulls it aside; no game code. Builder, README and a PlayMode test that checks the positions against the .NET pack reference bit for bit.

Needs the Stats pack (git URL https://github.com/IAFahim/tl.git?path=/packs/Stats). A hero's duel timeline (hits, poison, heal) and a Haste buff change Health and Attack; read-out top left. Builder, README and a PlayMode test (Health 64, 53, 72 at steps 200, 450, 600).

Needs the Inventory pack (git URL https://github.com/IAFahim/tl.git?path=/packs/Inventory). A backpack's Loot Run timeline gives, takes and crafts items and two Pickup markers drop Coins and a Gem; read-out top left, no game code. Builder, README and a PlayMode test (final bag Wood 1 Stone 3 Plank 2 Potion 1 Sword 1 Coin 10 Key 0 Gem 1).
Builds a Tl Demos scene with a button per imported demo scene and puts them all in the build list. Import the other demos first, then Tl > Samples > Build Demo Hub.

Runs the Inventory and Stats demo scenes from the portable scene format (no JSON, no Editor code) in an IL2CPP or CoreCLR player and prints whether each state hash equals the tl run hash. Needs the Inventory and Stats packs and the package tests (testables).
Runs the 600-step kind script and the events script in an IL2CPP or CoreCLR player and prints whether both hashes equal the .NET hashes. Needs the package tests (testables).
Sums game-code Damage pulses with timeline hit pulses into one Health write in a player and prints whether its hash equals the .NET hash. Needs the package tests (testables).
